independence_declaration.statement: I (code-security-reviewer) authored no implementation in the DG0 scope: gate tooling, runner, write guard, CI workflow, source extraction, agent definitions and analysis were authored by delivery-orchestrator and transformation-analyst. I formed this verdict without reading any other round-3 review record.

checks_run.procedure: Confirm the frozen candidate before reviewing. HEAD is 4af07b03, a post-freeze metadata-only commit: assignments, manifest and stages.json, all excluded by META_EXCLUDES. Recompute the candidate at the working tree and at the source commit, and diff it against the frozen manifest.
checks_run.command: git rev-parse HEAD; node tools/gates/candidate.mjs --stage DG0; node tools/gates/candidate.mjs --stage DG0 --ref 540b3c69a0e0477476eca0207b0b9c0aaded1ea9; node tools/gates/candidate.mjs --stage DG0 --diff; git diff --stat 540b3c69..HEAD
checks_run.environment: main repo (read-only commands), Node v22, git; Linux
checks_run.expected: candidate_id sha256:31fd0843977d30afd4459591abdfd730c5c994440030816188227d9f6ec4cbf9 at both the working tree and 540b3c69; diff matches; post-freeze commit touches only excluded metadata
checks_run.actual: Both print sha256:31fd0843...cbf9 (75 files); --diff shows matches:true with no added, removed or changed files; 540b3c69..HEAD touches only docs/delivery/assignments/DG0/round-3/*, candidates/DG0.manifest.json and stages.json

checks_run.procedure: Run the candidate's gate-validator and write-guard self-tests in a disposable worktree of the source commit
checks_run.command: git worktree add /tmp/dg0-sec-r3 540b3c69; cd /tmp/dg0-sec-r3; node --test tools/gates/tests/*.test.mjs tools/agents/tests/*.test.mjs
checks_run.environment: disposable git worktree /tmp/dg0-sec-r3 at 540b3c69, Node v22

checks_run.procedure: Direct source review: the full current tools/gates/lib/rules.mjs, lib/candidate.mjs, lib/schema.mjs, candidate.mjs, validate.mjs, import-findings.mjs, tools/agents/guard-write.mjs, run-agent.sh, write-scopes.json, per-role settings, .github/workflows/delivery-gates.yml and .gitattributes. Also the diff 83860be3..540b3c69 for tools/, decisions.md, agents.md and the schemas.
checks_run.command: git diff 83860be3ea4774688f0e00a87923edd6605d2ace..540b3c69a0e0477476eca0207b0b9c0aaded1ea9 -- tools .gitattributes docs/delivery/decisions.md docs/delivery/agents.md; cat -n <files>
checks_run.expected: no gate bypass, write-guard bypass or runner weakness
checks_run.actual: Defects found. rules.mjs:537-543 treats the evidence as append-only for deletions only (--diff-filter=D). Record, findings-sidecar and verifications-sidecar content is not bound to the run (F-DG0-115, High). rules.mjs:306 skips the assignment binding when a verifying record lacks 'assignment', and the verifying record is not schema-validated (:466-467), which keeps F-DG0-102 open. candidate.mjs:92 reads the working-tree mode from the filesystem (F-DG0-116, Low). rules.mjs:416-425 takes observation acceptance on the orchestrator's word (F-DG0-117, Low). The runner, CI workflow, settings, write-scopes, CSV parser, CLIs and source scripts are unchanged since round 2. CI: permissions contents:read, fetch-depth 0, actions pinned by SHA, and the job fails on a non-zero validator exit.

checks_run.procedure: Write reproduction tests (fixtures copied verbatim from the candidate's validator.test.mjs) for suspected bypasses and fix verifications, and run them against the candidate tools
checks_run.environment: disposable worktree /tmp/dg0-sec-r3 at 540b3c69; fixtures in mkdtemp git repos (removed by test.after), Node v22
checks_run.expected: BYPASS tests fail (the weakness is absent)
checks_run.actual: 10/10 tests pass, exit 0. The BYPASS tests pass, so the weaknesses are present. 115a (edit a committed sidecar and record: the gate passes in current and historical mode and in the pipeline), 115b (flip a committed FAIL verification to PASS), 115c (flip a committed FAIL verdict to PASS), 115d (a verifying record without an assignment skips the binding, see F-DG0-102), 117 (acceptance by role names only). The FIXED tests for F-DG0-101, F-DG0-102 N1a and F-DG0-112 pass.

checks_run.procedure: Reproduce the original round-2 failures against the round-2 candidate commit, as the baseline for the fix verification
checks_run.expected: N1a, N1b, N1c, N2, N3, N4, N5 and N6 reproduce on the old commit
checks_run.actual: 16/16 pass, exit 0. Every original bypass (N1a-N6) is present on 83860be3.

checks_run.procedure: Probe the write guard end to end through the real per-role hook command: nested .git planting, protected targets, NotebookEdit and MultiEdit payloads, and a garbage payload. Run on the old and the new commit.
checks_run.environment: disposable worktrees; bash; Node v22; role backend-workflow-engineer settings
checks_run.expected: candidate: .git paths and every protected target exit 2 even with a nested .git planted; product path exit 0; garbage exit 2
checks_run.actual: Old: planted .git un-protects everything (exit 0). Candidate: all .git and protected targets exit 2; src/ok.ts exit 0; garbage payload exit 2.

checks_run.procedure: Clone with core.autocrlf=true, check out the old and the new commit, and compare the working-tree candidate with the committed candidate
checks_run.command: git clone --no-checkout --config core.autocrlf=true . <scratch>; git checkout <c>; node tools/gates/candidate.mjs --stage DG0; node tools/gates/candidate.mjs --stage DG0 --ref <c>
checks_run.expected: candidate: working-tree ID equals the --ref ID
checks_run.actual: Old: 9c13ca68 vs d47b51ca (differ). Candidate: both sha256:31fd0843...cbf9.

checks_run.procedure: Compare D-016, D-018, D-019 and agents.md with the code (for F-DG0-114)
checks_run.command: grep D-016/D-018/D-019 docs/delivery/decisions.md; grep MTH_MAX_RESUMES tools/agents/run-agent.sh; sed -n 18,30p docs/delivery/agents.md; write-scopes.json protected list
checks_run.actual: D-019 says 6, matching run-agent.sh:22. agents.md matches write-scopes.json. D-016 matches rules.mjs:503-506, apart from the fail-open case tracked in F-DG0-102. D-018 correctly says 'deleted'.

checks_run.command: node -e '<walk tools/gates/schemas/*.json keywords vs supported set>'
checks_run.actual: findings, gate, review and stages schemas: unsupported none; formats: date-time only

checks_run.environment: disposable worktree /tmp/dg0-sec-head at 4af07b03, Node v22, python3
checks_run.expected: register, pipeline and reconcile PASS; --stage DG0 fails closed (no gate record yet); extraction reproducible
checks_run.actual: register PASS (0), pipeline PASS (0), reconcile PASS (0). --stage DG0 FAIL exit 1: 'gate DG0: file not found', the expected fail-closed result. check_extraction PASS (0): docx sha256 2584a352...548ad2, 165 and 423 blocks.

checks_run.procedure: Scan all tracked candidate files (excluding trading_agent/) and all 25 committed run transcripts for credentials, key files, emails and public CDNs
checks_run.command: git grep -nIE '<AWS/Anthropic/GitHub/Slack/Google key, private-key and assignment patterns>' 540b3c69 -- . ':!trading_agent'; zcat transcripts | grep -oE '<patterns>'
checks_run.actual: One hit: the regex text itself, quoted in my round-2 log. No key files and no CDN references. Emails: noreply@anthropic.com (commit trailer doc) and synthetic example.* addresses only. 0 of 25 transcripts contain secret patterns.

checks_run.procedure: Parse all ten agent frontmatters and compare their hook with the per-role settings used by the runner. Confirm that runner, CI, settings, scopes and the source scripts are unchanged since round 2.
checks_run.command: python3 <frontmatter parser> for .claude/agents/*.md; git diff --stat 83860be3 540b3c69 -- .github .claude tools/source tools/agents/run-agent.sh tools/agents/settings tools/agents/write-scopes.json tools/gates/lib/csv.mjs tools/gates/import-findings.mjs tools/gates/validate.mjs tools/gates/candidate.mjs
checks_run.expected: name equals the file name, model inherit, matcher Write|Edit|NotebookEdit|MultiEdit, hook command identical to settings, fails closed when the guard is missing
checks_run.actual: All 10 OK. The first attempt of my own parser had a quoting bug and was rerun; the log records this. The diff is empty: those files are unchanged since round 2.

checks_run.procedure: Remove the disposable worktrees and confirm that the source tree is unmodified
checks_run.command: git worktree remove --force /tmp/dg0-sec-r3 /tmp/dg0-sec-r2old /tmp/dg0-sec-head; git worktree prune; git status --short
checks_run.expected: worktrees removed; only review and evidence paths are untracked
checks_run.actual: All three removed. git status shows only docs/delivery/{reviews,runs,test-evidence}/ additions and no modified tracked files.

summary: FAIL. Six of my seven pending findings are verified fixed and closed: F-DG0-101, 110, 111, 112, 113 and 114. F-DG0-102 stays OPEN because the verification assignment binding fails open when the verifying record lacks 'assignment'. New: F-DG0-115 (High, mandatory). Reviewer-authored records and sidecars are not bound to their run, and the append-only history check covers deletions only. Editing committed review files in place drops a High finding, turns a FAIL verification into a closure, or turns a FAIL verdict into PASS, and the gate, historical mode and pipeline still pass. Two Low observations, which I would accept: F-DG0-116 (working-tree mode vs core.fileMode=false) and F-DG0-117 (observation acceptance is not bound to any reviewer artefact).
